findings.obligation: Independent complete candidates must remain exposed when another description/source is incomplete or conflicting
findings.cause: Gateway returns NEEDS_INPUT for any inventory issue (gateway.ts:61), even when loader retains complete candidate. Projected-source loader also drops every candidate on a single HOST_SOURCE_STALE (inventory.ts:141).
findings.actual: 5 canonical variants retain complete in loader, all six produce response:null and mock providerCalls:0 in gateway; generated mismatch returns skills:[] earlier.
findings.dedup: One candidate-isolation obligation failure group, with gateway and projected-loader locations; do not count per variant. Not the previously reported duplicated metadata-condition parsing bug.

findings.obligation: Late source revision results must not remain current; final AGENT overwrite separately unobserved
findings.cause: Gateway getCurrentSnapshot returns spread of initial inventoryDigest and checks task/runtime only (gateway.ts:85-88); index observeRuntime excludes skill metadata source bytes.
findings.actual: After subject removal/disable, delayed mock returns SUCCESS with old inventory and subject needed. agentSelectedSkillIds remains null; validateDecision with current digest returns STALE_inventoryDigest.
findings.dedup: Connect to previously known current-state/concurrency recheck gap; this is the source-metadata in-flight manifestation, not an extra duplicated race root. Host active membership supply gap was not reproduced: synthetic registry.enabled explicitly supplies the state.
